title: The reading theorems: a read carried port bounds the bond; bounded or linear
claim: In a living in-scope nested NAE family: (R) a carried main port in a knot with an own distinction of a covered copy at depth s gives L(s) <= 3 unless {p,x} is free and the third member is tied opposite to p or x; (R1) with the third member an own pendant distinction, L(s) <= 3 with no exception; (C') under conditional rectangularity a bond holding the carried ports has its other members on one side of each member-free stretch; (Dichotomy) on each residue modulo m!, L is eventually bounded or at least s/(m+1) - 1, by pumping member-free stretches. Claim 2' second part open.
standard_statement: Least minimal non-shattered sets through a root vertex and a depth-s vertex in iterated hyperedge-replacement NAE instances: a three-element certificate from an identity-carried root vertex in a hyperedge with a depth-s vertex, and an eventually-bounded-or-linear dichotomy by pumping a finite-state semigroup along member-free stretches.
prior_work: CARRY-BOUND-20261114-001 (Lemma W, widened B, Lemma G); classical pumping of finite semigroup states.

validation.status: hand proofs, checked twice by the advisor model (a colleague's check); referee pending

remaining_obligations: Claim 2' second part (at most 2^h clusters) is open
foundation_claim_scope: Statements about bonds in nested NAE families; no knot, contact or topology claim beyond them.
completion_gate: The proofs of R, R1, C' (1', 2' first part) and the dichotomy written and checked.
